## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change, squashed to a single commit where possible
- [ ] Tests added or updated, or the summary explains why not
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed
- [ ] No real patient data, credentials, or secrets (including in screenshots)
- [ ] Patient-facing text explains without diagnosing, and interpreted content
      points back to the care team
- [ ] AI assistance disclosed with a `Co-authored-by` trailer, if any was used
